criterion: Null in the contract (Effective Java item 54)
finding: attached entries carry filename/mimeType null when read_back is false or the id is absent from the read-back, undocumented; an id absent from a successful read-back is mislabelled `stored differently`.
why: A consumer reading attached[i].filename gets null with no stated contract, and the `stored differently` reason is wrong when nothing was listed under that id.
fix: Document the null case in ADAPTERS.md, CONTRACT.md and the tool docstring; give an id missing from a successful read-back its own reason such as `not in the read-back`.
evidence: found = by_id.get(att_id) or {} ... attached.append({"file": path, "id": att_id, **got}) ... if read_back and got != sent: ... "reason": "stored differently"
